sections.title: Light Spirits
sections.note: Lift the Twilight from three provinces and find the three Fused Shadows.

items.name: Three days in Ordon
items.howTo: Win back Uli's cradle from the monkey with the hawk, buy the Slingshot at Sera's Sundries, herd the goats on Epona and bring Talo back from the Faron Woods with the Wooden Sword.
items.notes: The Fishing Rod is Colin's, given by Uli when you return her cradle. On the third day Bulblins carry off Ilia and Colin at Ordon Spring, and a Twilight hand drags Link through the wall into the Faron Woods.

items.name: Escape Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: As a wolf, dig out of the cell with Midna's help, cross the sewers and the rooftops and climb the tower to meet Zelda.
items.notes: Midna then takes Link back to Ordon Spring.

items.name: Ordon Sword and Ordon Shield
items.howTo: Still a wolf, take the Ordon Shield from Jaggle and Pergie's house (knock it down from the window) and the Ordon Sword from Rusl's house, then leave by Ordon Spring.

items.name: Faron Twilight
items.howTo: Fill the Vessel of Light with the Twilight Insects' 16 Tears of Light in the Faron Woods, then bring them to the spring.
items.reward: 16 Tears of Light, Hero's Clothes; the Light Spirit Faron returns Link to human form
items.notes: HD: 12 Tears of Light in each Twilight area instead of 16.

items.name: Forest Temple
items.howTo: Buy the Lantern from Coro (or get it back from the monkey), cross the woods to the temple and free the eight monkeys.
items.notes: Boss: Diababa. Mini-boss: Ook. Dungeon item: Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Eldin Twilight
items.howTo: Pass the Twilight wall at the Kakariko Gorge and gather the 16 Tears of Light in Kakariko Village, Death Mountain and Eldin's fields.
items.reward: 16 Tears of Light; Light Spirit Eldin
items.notes: Afterwards Link tames Epona when the Bulblins charge through Kakariko. HD: 12 Tears of Light.

items.name: Wrestle Bo
items.howTo: The Gorons won't let you up Death Mountain. Go home and win at sumo against Mayor Bo in his house.
items.notes: Then beat a Goron at sumo on Death Mountain to be let into the mines.

items.name: Goron Mines
items.howTo: Wear the Iron Boots to hold your ground against the Gorons on the trail, then beat Gor Coron at sumo at the top.
items.notes: Boss: Fyrus. Mini-boss: Dangoro. Dungeon item: Hero's Bow.

items.name: King Bulblin's raid
items.howTo: When the Bulblins take Colin from Kakariko, chase them across Eldin on Epona and joust King Bulblin on the Bridge of Eldin.
items.notes: Afterwards Midna warps the missing span of the Bridge of Eldin back from the Gerudo Mesa, opening the way to Lanayru.

items.name: Lanayru Twilight
items.area: Lake Hylia, Zora's Domain and Castle Town
items.howTo: Gather the 16 Tears of Light across Lanayru: the dried-up Lake Hylia, Zora's River, the frozen Zora's Domain and Castle Town.
items.reward: 16 Tears of Light; Light Spirit Lanayru
items.notes: Lanayru shows Link the history of the Fused Shadows. HD: 12 Tears of Light.

items.name: Escort Telma's wagon
items.howTo: In Telma's Bar in Castle Town, agree to take Ilia and Prince Ralis to Kakariko. Ride ahead of the wagon and shoot the Bulblins' flaming arrows and the torches before they reach it.
items.notes: Use the Gale Boomerang to put out fires on the wagon.

items.name: Queen Rutela's gift
items.howTo: Follow Queen Rutela's ghost through the graveyard behind Kakariko to King Zora's grave.

items.name: Lakebed Temple
items.howTo: In the Zora Armor, sink to the lake bed with the Iron Boots and blast the rocks over the entrance with Water Bombs.
items.notes: Boss: Morpheel. Mini-boss: Deku Toad. Dungeon item: Clawshot.

sections.title: Mirror of Twilight
sections.note: The Master Sword, then the four Mirror Shards.

items.name: Midna's Desperate Hour
items.howTo: Zant takes the Fused Shadows and curses Link back into a wolf. Carry the dying Midna across Hyrule Field to Zelda at Hyrule Castle.
items.notes: Zelda gives her life to save Midna.

items.name: Master Sword
items.howTo: Chase the Skull Kid through the Sacred Grove, beat the two guardian statues' puzzle and draw the Master Sword from its pedestal.
items.notes: The sword lifts Zant's curse; from now on Link can change form at will.

items.name: Fly to the desert
items.howTo: Auru, at Lake Hylia, gives you a memo for Fyer. Show it to Fyer and ride his cannon to the Gerudo Desert.

items.name: Arbiter's Grounds
items.howTo: Cross the desert to the Bulblin camp, take its key from the Bulblins and fight King Bulblin to reach the prison beyond.
items.notes: Boss: Stallord. Mini-boss: Death Sword. Dungeon item: Spinner. The Mirror of Twilight lies shattered in the Mirror Chamber above; one shard remains in place.

items.name: Reekfish Scent
items.howTo: Prince Ralis gives you the Coral Earring at his mother's grave. Hook it to the Fishing Rod and catch a Reekfish in Zora's Domain, then follow its scent up Snowpeak as a wolf.
items.notes: Ashei, at the foot of Snowpeak, gives you her sketch of the Reekfish.

items.name: Snowpeak Ruins
items.howTo: Follow Yeto to the mansion; snowboard down to it on his pot lid.
items.notes: Boss: Blizzeta. Mini-boss: Darkhammer. Dungeon item: Ball and Chain. Gather the pumpkin and cheese for Yeto's soup on the way.

items.name: Temple of Time
items.howTo: Return to the Sacred Grove, beat the Skull Kid again and step through the Master Sword's pedestal into the past.
items.notes: Boss: Armogohma. Mini-boss: Darknut. Dungeon item: Dominion Rod.

items.name: Ilia's memory
items.howTo: Take Renado's Letter to Telma, Telma's Invoice to Doctor Borville and his Wooden Statue to Ilia. Clear the Hidden Village of Bulblins for Impaz, who gives you Ilia's Charm.
items.notes: Impaz gives the Ancient Sky Book; Ilia, her memory back, gives the Horse Call. Renado's letter arrives after the Temple of Time.

items.name: Sky characters
items.howTo: Show Shad the Ancient Sky Book under Renado's sanctuary: its first character restores the Dominion Rod. Move the six Owl Statues around Hyrule with the rod to find the missing sky characters, then bring the finished book back to Shad to wake the Sky Cannon.
items.notes: Fyer moves the cannon to Lake Hylia; ride it up to the City in the Sky.

items.name: City in the Sky
items.howTo: Fire the Sky Cannon at Lake Hylia.
items.notes: Boss: Argorok. Mini-boss: Aeralfos. Dungeon item: a second Clawshot (Double Clawshots).

sections.title: Twilight's End
sections.note: The Palace of Twilight and Hyrule Castle.

items.name: Palace of Twilight
items.howTo: With the Mirror of Twilight whole again, step through it into the Twilight Realm.
items.notes: Boss: Zant. Mini-boss: Phantom Zant. No new item: the two Sols fill the Master Sword with light. Midna takes back the Fused Shadows.

items.name: Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: Midna breaks the barrier around the castle. Climb to the throne room.
items.notes: Final boss: Ganondorf (Puppet Zelda, Dark Beast Ganon, then on horseback and sword to sword). Mini-boss: King Bulblin.
